title: Early North Barnes vision published
summary: Promoter concept material described a new settlement at North Barnes Farm with homes, community facilities, green infrastructure and substantial open-space provision.

title: Site assessed through Lewes local-plan evidence
summary: Council evidence assessed the site at roughly 184 hectares and considered strategic housing capacity at around 3,000-plus homes, subject to infrastructure and planning constraints.

title: Environmental assessment and design work progresses
summary: The emerging scheme is described as a new settlement of up to about 3,000 homes with commercial, employment, education, health, sports, landscape, drainage and transport infrastructure. Detailed engineering remains under development.

title: Public consultation and revised settlement strategy
summary: Current public material includes a local centre, supermarket, light-industrial space, primary and early-years provision, health facilities, sports provision, nature reserve, valley park and active-travel links.
